patch.value: update-many silently drops a null update field in the flat transport instead of clearing it or refusing

Found by Codex review of the GH-1655 change (pm-gh1655). updateManyOptionsFromFlat in src/sdk/runtime-input.ts normalizes a flat update field whose value is null to undefined, so runAction('update-many', { ids: [id], assignee: null, description: 'changed' }) changes the description and silently keeps the assignee. The nested form ({ update: { assignee: null } }) reaches resolveUpdateTransportOptions and is folded into unset by pm-gh1655, so the two spellings of one request disagree. The flat form mixes selection filters and update fields in one record, which is why pm-gh1655 kept update-many out of the null-clear contract (PmUpdateManyActionOptions stays non-nullable).

A flat update-many payload with a null update field either clears it like the nested form or refuses naming the field and the unset form; it never silently drops it; Flat and nested update-many spellings of the same request produce the same rows, with a spec for each
A null update field in a flat update-many payload clears or refuses
The flat payload drops the null field silently while the rest of the update applies
